subject: Request: Trial extension & sandbox credits due to integration backlog
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@novapulse.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ethan Wallace <ethan.wallace@novapulse.io>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Onboarding delay — request for trial extension and sandbox credits

Hi Vivek,

Quick note from our engineering side: we hit an unexpected blocker in the SSO adapter during our staging cutover. The team traced it to a dependency mismatch in the third-party connector that will take at least two more sprint days to stabilize. That means our pilot demo (next week) is at risk and we won't be able to produce the evaluation traffic needed to validate the model prompts.

We signed up for the 30-day trial and were planning to start load runs this week — any chance Redwood can grant a 45–60 day extension to the trial window plus a small sandbox credit top-up so our engineers can run tests after we clear the blocker? We appreciate anything you can do here while we knock down this debt.

Thanks — Samira
Samira Khan
Head of Platform, Novapulse
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@novapulse.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding delay — request for trial extension and sandbox credits

Hi Samira — thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear about the SSO hiccup. We've seen this pattern before and are happy to help keep your pilot on track.

Proposed next steps from my side:
- I'll loop in Marissa (solutions engineer) to get a quick read on the technical timeline and whether we can provide a targeted test harness.
- Ben (AE) will scope a commercial/credits response so we can keep your sandbox active while you finish the fix.

Can you confirm the earliest date your team expects to be ready to run the token-heavy evals? If it's two weeks, we can discuss a 45-day extension; if closer to four weeks we should look at 60 days + a small credits grant.

I'll follow up internally and aim to get a concrete offer to you by Tuesday.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@novapulse.io>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding delay — request for trial extension and sandbox credits

Thanks Vivek — Samira, quick technical note from my side after looking at the stack trace you shared offline: the SSO adapter mismatch will require a small change to your auth shim and a scripted data replay to confirm KV cache behavior. I'd budget ~10 engineer-hours to patch and validate. If helpful, I can push a small test harness and a step-by-step runbook — attaching a zipped log bundle from our replication (integration_logs.zip) and a short plan (proposed-mtp-plan.pdf).

If your team can give us a target date for running load tests we can align the sandbox window. From a risk perspective, a 60-day extension is safer — gives us room for the fix and a second pass of evals. For credits, I'd propose a 1,000 USD sandbox uplift (covers generated tokens + streaming tests) so you can exercise the full evaluation without surprises.

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: integration_logs.zip (zip, 2.1MB)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@novapulse.io>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding delay — request for trial extension and sandbox credits

Looping finance/approvals — Neha, any objection to a 60-day trial extension + $1,000 in sandbox credits for Novapulse (deal NP-1093)? Customer is blocked on an adapter issue; SE verified it's ~10 hours of work and they need runway to validate. It's standard make-good for pilot pacing.

Samira — we can also schedule a 30-minute troubleshooting session with Marissa this week to accelerate the fix. If that helps, let us know a couple of times that work for your engineers.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Samira Khan <samira@novapulse.io>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding delay — request for trial extension and sandbox credits

Approved — grant a 60-day extension to Novapulse's trial window starting from their original trial start date (no backdating) and issue a $1,000 sandbox credit voucher tied to DEAL NP-1093. Please document the approval in HubSpot (link below) and flag any further escalations.

Action items:
- Ben to create credit voucher and update HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/contact/NP-1093
- Marissa to run a 30-minute troubleshooting session and share the patched runbook.
- Vivek to confirm extension start date with Samira and send the official credit voucher link.

Neha Kapoor
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

On Sun, Jul 25, 2027 at 12:30 PM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Samira — thanks for the heads up and sorry to hear about the SSO hiccup...
